children: India‑designed smartphone debuts with 3D Curved AMOLED Display, vegan leather finish, Rear Mini Screen, Vayu AI and a 6000mAh battery, available on Flipkart from 28 September

Lava International has introduced the Virat Curve 5G, a smartphone envisioned, designed and developed in India, positioned in the Rs 20,000 segment. With its 3D Curved AMOLED Display, premium vegan leather finish, and a distinctive Rear Mini Screen, the device blends aesthetics with functionality, offering a compact yet sophisticated footprint.

Sumit Singh, Senior Vice President and Head of Product, Lava International Limited, described the launch as “a testament to innovation, consumer sentiments and an ambition to democratise the premium experience,” highlighting the Curve’s combination of design, power and intelligence.
Display And Distinctive Rear Mini Screen

The Virat Curve 5G features a 6.67‑inch FHD+ 3D Curved AMOLED Display with 120Hz refresh rate, 10‑bit colour depth, and 1.07 billion colours, delivering immersive visuals. With 1100 nits peak brightness and 1920Hz PWM dimming**, the display ensures clarity in bright sunlight and comfort in low‑light conditions.

Adding a functional twist, the **Rear Mini Screen** allows users to check notifications, customise texts and emojis, and view essentials such as clock, battery status and volume without unlocking the phone.

At its core, the Virat Curve 5G runs on the **MediaTek Dimensity 7100 Octa‑Core (6nm)** processor, scoring over **800K on AnTuTu**. It comes with **6GB LPDDR5 RAM** (expandable with up to 6GB virtual RAM) and **128GB storage**, ensuring smooth multitasking and ample space.
The device debuts Vayu AI, Lava’s humanised AI experience, designed to make intelligent features more natural, accessible and practical for everyday use.

A 6000mAh battery powers the Virat Curve 5G, delivering up to 55 hours of talk time, 11 hours of YouTube playback, and 720 hours of standby. Charging is supported by 45W fast charging, with a 33W charger included in the box.

The smartphone is equipped with a 50MP Sony IMX752 sensor with EIS and 2K video recording, alongside modes such as Night, Pro Video, Dual‑View Video and Sports. The 13MP front camera ensures clear selfies and video calls.
Connectivity features include Dual Stereo Speakers, Dual Mic Noise Cancellation, IR Blaster support, and an in‑display fingerprint sensor with Face Unlock.

The Virat Curve 5G is built with IronGuard Protection, Al‑Si DT Star 2 Cover Glass, MIL‑STD‑810H certification, and IP64 dust and water resistance. It runs on Android 16, free from bloatware and ads, with two years of OS upgrades and three years of security updates.
Lava’s new UI will debut on the device via an upcoming SMR update, alongside enhancements to **Vayu AI** and a native Gallery app.
The Virat Curve 5G is backed by Lava’s **Free Service @ Home**, offering convenient doorstep after‑sales support across India.
The Virat Curve 5G (6GB + 128GB) will be available in Heritage Indigo, Makrana Ivory and Ellora Slate colour options, exclusively on Flipkart from 28 September 2026 at 7 PM.
This launch positions Lava as a strong contender in the mid‑premium smartphone segment, combining design, intelligence and durability with a distinctly Indian identity.
